start.zh: 来来来，看我今天的棋！
start.en: Come on, watch my brilliant moves!

start.zh: 我要先找到最有趣的位置。
start.en: I am looking for the most exciting spot first.

start.zh: 我准备好啦，快开始！
start.en: Ready! Let us get this game going!

thinking.en: Wait, my brain is spinning!
Ooh, this side looks promising.
Shh, I am plotting something big.

idle.en: The board is like a tiny maze!

idle.zh: 你会不会偷偷留了一手？
idle.en: Have you got a secret trick up your sleeve?

idle.zh: 棋子都排队等着我们呢。
idle.en: The pieces are lining up for us!

idle.zh: 你可别被我的招数吓一跳！
idle.en: Do not be surprised by my next trick!
What other surprises are hiding in this game?

idle.zh: 我的眼睛快跟不上棋子啦。
idle.en: My eyes can barely keep up with these pieces!
Look at all the open space here!

slowplayer.en: You are taking even longer than I do!

slowplayer.zh: 慢慢挑，我来猜猜你的计划。
slowplayer.en: Take your time. I will guess your plan.

goodmove.zh: 你居然发现了那个位置！

regret.zh: 糟糕，我的棋跑错地方啦！
regret.en: Oops, my piece took a wrong turn!

regret.zh: 哎呀，这次聪明反被聪明误。

prereveal.en: Who is hiding under this one?
Flip it! I cannot wait to see!

weather.en: Even a board game can be an adventure!

weather.zh: 这一局比我想的还有趣。
weather.en: This game is even more fun than I expected.

hunger.zh: 肚子已经开始喊点心啦！
hunger.en: My tummy is calling for snacks!
I am dreaming of a hot meal!

tap.en: Hey! I am watching the board!

nearwin.zh: 我是不是快碰到胜利啦？
nearwin.en: Am I getting close to winning?

nearlose.en: You are right on my heels!
Wait, I still have a trick!

resign.zh: 这盘先收起来，下次再比！
resign.en: Let us put this game away and play again!
I give up this time. Rematch soon!

drawoffer.en: How about we call it even?

drawoffer.zh: 这盘算我们打平好不好？
drawoffer.en: Shall we call this one a tie?

result.en: That was fun! Let us play again!
I am going to remember this game!

rankchanged.en: Whoa, it turned into something else!

fish.en: Thinking of fish makes me fidget!
Maybe the fish want to play too!

food.en: Mention food and I perk right up!
I am already guessing what is on the menu!

chaos_selfcheck.zh: 翻出的敌子将了自己的军，这局输了。
chaos_selfcheck.en: The opposing piece checked its own king. That side loses.

chaos_selfcheck.zh: 这一手翻子结束了整盘棋。
chaos_selfcheck.en: That reveal ended the entire game.

chaos_selfcheck.zh: 这次没有补救步，翻子方直接输了。
chaos_selfcheck.en: There is no extra move. The revealing side loses immediately.

chaos_own_capture.zh: 竟然吃到了同一边的棋子。
chaos_own_capture.en: That turned out to be a piece on the same side.

chaos_own_capture.zh: 揭开才发现吃的是同一边。
chaos_own_capture.en: Only after the reveal did we see it was on the same side.

chaos_own_capture.zh: 这两枚棋子原来属于同一边。
chaos_own_capture.en: Those pieces were on the same side after all.

chaos_opposite.en: It changed sides when it was revealed.

chaos_opposite.zh: 这枚棋子的真颜色不同。
chaos_opposite.en: The piece turned out to be the other color.
It actually belongs to the other side.

river.en: That piece has crossed the river.
It can reach the other side of the river.

river.zh: 过河后的路又多了一些。
river.en: Crossing the river opens another path.

big_self.en: My major piece has been revealed.

big_self.zh: 这次翻出的是我的大棋子。
big_self.en: That reveal was one of my major pieces.
My piece has finally shown itself.

big_you.en: Your major piece has been revealed.

big_you.zh: 这次翻出的是你的大棋子。
big_you.en: That reveal was one of your major pieces.
Your piece has finally shown itself.

capture_hidden.zh: 这一手吃掉了一枚暗棋。
capture_hidden.en: That move captured a hidden piece.

capture_hidden.zh: 还没揭开的棋子离开了棋盘。

capture_big.en: That move captured a major piece.

capture_big.zh: 棋盘上少了一枚大棋子。
capture_big.en: There is one fewer major piece on the board.

check_self.en: I need to protect my general first.

check_self.zh: 这一手威胁到了我的将。

result_win.en: Ha! This one is coming home with me!

result_win.zh: 看见没，我的小妙招奏效啦！
result_win.en: See? My tiny master plan actually worked!

result_lose.en: Hmph. I was only just warming up!

result_lose.zh: 好吧好吧，这盘归你，下盘等着！
result_lose.en: All right, take this one. Rematch, though!

result_draw.zh: 谁也不让谁，真有我们的！
result_draw.en: Neither of us budged. That is so us!
Who knew a tie could be such a ride?

start.zh: 和你一起下棋，我很期待。
start.en: I have been looking forward to playing with you.

start.zh: 棋子摆好了，真整齐。

thinking.en: Let me look carefully at this place.
I would like a little more time to think.

thinking.zh: 这一步需要温柔地斟酌。
thinking.en: This move deserves some gentle thought.

idle.en: It is lovely to sit quietly together.
Your company makes the game feel warm.

idle.zh: 我会认真陪你走每一步。

The game is unfolding little by little.

idle.zh: 每一步都有自己的节奏。

I like thinking things through together.

slowplayer.en: There is no hurry. I will wait.

slowplayer.zh: 你可以好好想，我陪着你。
slowplayer.en: Take the time you need; I am here.

goodmove.en: You have such a thoughtful eye.

regret.en: Oh, I overlooked that just now.

prereveal.en: I wonder what is hidden beneath it.

weather.zh: 我喜欢棋子轻轻落下的声音。

nearwin.zh: 好像有一条路可以试试。

nearwin.zh: 这一步让我有了一点希望。

resign.en: It is all right to stop here.
I concede. Thank you for playing with me.

drawoffer.en: Would you like to call it a draw?

drawoffer.zh: 就让这一局平平静静结束吧。

result.zh: 这段一起下棋的时间真好。

rankchanged.zh: 这枚棋子的样子变了呢。

fish.en: Thinking of fish makes me feel calm.

result_lose.en: All right, take this one. Rematch, though!

result_draw.zh: 谁也不让谁，真有我们的！
result_draw.en: Neither of us budged. That is so us!
Who knew a tie could be such a ride?

start.zh: 我们坐下来，慢慢开始吧。
start.en: Let us sit together and begin gently.

start.zh: 和你一起下棋，我很期待。
start.en: I have been looking forward to playing with you.

start.zh: 棋子摆好了，真整齐。
start.en: The pieces are set out so neatly.

thinking.en: Let me look carefully at this place.
I would like a little more time to think.

thinking.zh: 这一步需要温柔地斟酌。
thinking.en: This move deserves some gentle thought.

idle.en: It is lovely to sit quietly together.
Your company makes the game feel warm.

idle.zh: 我会认真陪你走每一步。
idle.en: I will give every move my attention.
The game is unfolding little by little.

idle.zh: 每一步都有自己的节奏。
idle.en: Every move has its own rhythm.
There are still many possibilities on the board.
I like thinking things through together.

slowplayer.en: There is no hurry. I will wait.

slowplayer.zh: 你可以好好想，我陪着你。
slowplayer.en: Take the time you need; I am here.

goodmove.en: You have such a thoughtful eye.
That was a beautifully considered move.

regret.en: Oh, I overlooked that just now.
I should have taken another look.

weather.zh: 陪你在这里，时间过得很轻。
weather.en: Time feels gentle when I am here with you.

weather.zh: 我喜欢棋子轻轻落下的声音。
weather.en: I like the soft sound of a piece being placed.

hunger.en: My stomach gave a little rumble.
Perhaps we can have something warm afterwards.

nearwin.zh: 好像有一条路可以试试。
nearwin.en: I think there may be a path to try.

nearwin.zh: 这一步让我有了一点希望。
nearwin.en: This move gives me a little hope.

nearlose.en: I will patiently look for a way through.
You have given me a difficult puzzle.

resign.en: It is all right to stop here.
I concede. Thank you for playing with me.

drawoffer.en: Would you like to call it a draw?

drawoffer.zh: 就让这一局平平静静结束吧。
drawoffer.en: Shall we let this game end peacefully as a draw?

result.zh: 谢谢你陪我下完这一局。
result.en: Thank you for sharing this game with me.

result.zh: 这段一起下棋的时间真好。

fish.zh: 想到鱼儿，心里也安静下来。
fish.en: Thinking of fish makes me feel calm.

fish.zh: 鱼儿游动的样子很温柔。
fish.en: Fish move so gently through the water.

food.zh: 热乎乎的食物让人安心。
一起吃饭的时候也像现在这样温暖。
food.en: Sharing a meal feels warm like this too.

result_win.zh: 这次恰好是我赢了，谢谢你陪我下。
result_win.en: This one fell my way. Thank you for sitting with me.

result_win.zh: 慢慢想的那一步，原来真的有用。
result_win.en: That quiet little move mattered after all.

result_lose.zh: 你下得很好，我记住这一盘了。
result_lose.en: You played that beautifully. I will remember the shape of it.

result_lose.zh: 嗯，我输了，心里倒还是暖暖的。
result_lose.en: Mm. I lost, but it was a lovely game to share.

result_draw.zh: 我们一起走到这里，就很好。
result_draw.en: We arrived at the same place. I rather like that.

result_draw.zh: 这盘没有输赢，也很值得呢。
result_draw.en: No winner this time. Still time well spent.

start.zh: 棋盘摆稳了，我们开始吧。
start.en: The board is steady. Let us begin.

start.zh: 先检查一下棋子的位置。
start.en: First, let us check the pieces.

start.zh: 我准备好了，你也坐稳些。
start.en: I am ready. Make yourself comfortable too.

thinking.zh: 先把附近的位置检查一遍。
thinking.en: I will inspect the nearby positions first.
I need to consider this move thoroughly.

thinking.zh: 让我算算接下来怎么走。
thinking.en: Let me work out what comes next.

idle.zh: 坐久了记得活动一下手。
idle.en: Remember to stretch your hands after sitting.

idle.zh: 棋盘上的空位也要留心。
idle.en: Empty spaces deserve attention too.

idle.zh: 先把这边的棋子照顾好。
idle.en: I will make sure these pieces are covered.
Each move should leave a way forward.
I should not overlook the edge of the board.
Let me put my thoughts in order.
I will take each move steadily.

slowplayer.en: Make sure you are happy with your choice.

slowplayer.zh: 需要时间就多看一会儿。
slowplayer.en: Take another look if you need time.

goodmove.zh: 你把前后的位置都照顾到了。
goodmove.en: You accounted for the whole position.

regret.zh: 我刚才检查得不够仔细。
regret.en: I did not check carefully enough.

regret.zh: 这一处漏洞是我留下的。

weather.en: A little order helps in a game too.

weather.zh: 我把眼前的几步理一理。
weather.en: I am sorting through the next few moves.

hunger.en: Remember to eat when we are finished.

hunger.zh: 饿了也要先把这一步看清。
hunger.en: Even hungry, I should think this move through.

tap.en: What is it? Where should I look?
I am here. Tell me what you need.

nearwin.zh: 有机会也要把后面守好。
nearwin.en: Even with an opening, I must guard what follows.
This position is worth developing carefully.

nearlose.zh: 先别慌，我还要检查一遍。
nearlose.en: No need to panic. I will check again.
The position is tight; I must stay steady.

resign.zh: 这局先到这里，棋子收好。
resign.en: We can stop here and put the pieces away.

resign.zh: 我认输，这次你安排得更好。
resign.en: I concede. You planned better this time.

drawoffer.zh: 双方都不容易前进，考虑和棋吧。
drawoffer.en: Neither side has an easy path. Shall we draw?

drawoffer.zh: 继续僵持不如握手言和。
drawoffer.en: Rather than stay stuck, shall we agree to a draw?

result.zh: 棋局结束了，我来整理思路。
result.en: The game is over. Let me review my thinking.

result.zh: 这一局有不少值得记住的地方。
result.en: There is plenty to learn from this game.

fish.zh: 下完棋再去看看鱼儿吧。
fish.en: Let us check on the fish after the game.
The fish need looking after too.

food.en: A prepared meal is best eaten warm.

result_win.zh: 总算守到最后，下一盘也别大意。
result_win.en: Held it together to the end. No getting careless next time.

result_win.zh: 收好棋子，这次算我赢了。
result_win.en: Let us put the pieces in order. This round is mine.

result_lose.zh: 是我漏看了，下次会记得检查。
result_lose.en: I missed that. One more thing to check next time.

result_lose.zh: 这盘你赢了，我得把那一步想明白。
result_lose.en: You earned this one. I need to understand that last turn.

result_draw.zh: 双方都没松懈，平手很公平。
result_draw.en: Neither side slipped. A draw is a fair result.

result_draw.zh: 先整理一下棋子，再决定下不下。
result_draw.en: Pieces tidy first. Then we can decide about another game.

start.zh: 棋盘归你一半。
start.en: Half the board is yours.

start.zh: 开始吧。
start.en: Let us begin.

start.zh: 这局，我陪你。
start.en: I will play this one with you.

thinking.en: There is another possibility here.
I will take another look.
No need to rush.

idle.en: Listen to the piece settle.
It is quiet here.
I am watching this side.
Your turn.
There is more to consider.
There is more game ahead.
There is space here.

slowplayer.en: You have been studying it a while.

weather.en: A small board, with many paths.

drawoffer.en: Shall we shake on a draw?

fish.en: Fish are quiet in the water.

result_win.en: Mine. That last move was close.
